native_findings: MainServerAgentBridge.start() is the native main-process lifetime boundary: each main process constructs and starts a fresh bridge.
MainServerAgentBridge.publish_analyze_request() / AgentServerEventBridge analyze receive path already provide the ordered main→agent PUSH/PULL lane used by turn-check and receipt barrier traffic.
agent_intent_restore_signal is client-session scoped and occurs on ordinary refresh/reconnect, so it cannot safely identify a main-process restart.
The green-base effect-state candidate already owns delivery_claimed→delivery_uncertain and provides outbox_mark_main_restart_uncertain(); no new ledger/store is required.
restart_reconciliation_reuse.decision: Reuse MainServerAgentBridge lifetime and the existing analyze socket. Give each bridge instance an ephemeral epoch, announce it at bridge startup, and stamp receipt barriers with it. Agent keeps only the last observed epoch in process memory; a changed epoch calls the existing NekoClaw-ledger outbox_mark_main_restart_uncertain() primitive. No new store/router/daemon/outbox/publication authority.
restart_reconciliation_reuse.why_ephemeral_epoch: If agent_server restarts too, Ledger.open already freezes claimed rows as uncertain. The epoch exists only to detect main-only restart while the agent process survives, so persisting a second epoch authority is unnecessary.

failed_probe.step: Exercise native delivery receipt real-ZMQ E2E
failed_probe.symptom: MainServerAgentBridge.start() logged that the NekoClaw main epoch announcement was not queued, then the real-ZMQ verifier timed out waiting for the startup epoch.
failed_probe.reproduced_gap: The one-shot zmq.NOBLOCK epoch send may run before the native ANALYZE PUSH/PULL connection has completed its handshake. A main-only restart can therefore leave an already-claimed visible effect stranded as claimed with no reconciliation signal.
failed_probe.correction_decision: Reuse the existing acknowledged analyze channel and waiter/retry machinery. Add an epoch ACK after agent-side observation and let startup schedule a bounded reliable announcement through the same native bridge. No new transport, router, journal, daemon, state store, or publication authority.
failed_probe.gate_policy: Fix implementation/evidence only; do not weaken or bypass the real-ZMQ gate.
